title: Space Header style picks (Overlay, Height, Buttons) show on the Space page

source.ref: Owner report 2026-11-17 (project thread: Fix Space header overlay options), /spaces/hq with Blend picked

detail:
Identity & Branding saves the header Overlay (None / Shade / Blend), Height (Short / Standard / Tall) and Buttons (In a row / Stacked) to space preferences, and the save works (setSpaceCoverScrim, setSpaceHeroLook). But the Frequency Space chrome (FqSpaceChrome, LIVE-1029) never took any of the three: the profile layout did not read coverScrim, never passed hero.height or hero.buttonOrientation, and space-page.css drew one fixed dark gradient at one fixed 440px height. So every pick saved and nothing on the page changed. Not a regression from #5195; the chrome rewrite dropped the inputs.

DONE 2026-11-18: the profile layout reads the overlay and passes it with the hero height and button layout; the chrome stamps data-scrim / data-height / data-buttons on the hero; space-page.css gives None (no shade, soft text shadow), Blend (fade to the page ground, page ink text, follows light and dark), Short 320px / Tall 576px (Standard stays 440px) and Stacked (a column of buttons).

verify.note: Passes while every Header style pick is read, handed to the chrome, stamped and styled.
